name: Labdane
note: C20 parent skeleton with a decalin-derived core. CPP is labdane related. This PubChem parent model does not imply that every labdane shares the displayed stereochemistry.
noteKo: C20 parent skeleton with a decalin-derived core. CPP is labdane related. This PubChem parent model does not imply that every labdane shares the displayed stereochemistry.

name: Halimane
note: A C20 skeleton related to labdane through methyl migration in class II cyclisation mechanisms. HPP is halimane-related. This parent connectivity model leaves stereochemistry unspecified.
noteKo: Class II 고리화 기전에서 methyl 이동을 통해 labdane과 연결되는 C20 골격이다. HPP는 halimane 계열에 속한다. 이 모체의 결합 관계 모형에는 입체배열을 지정하지 않았다.

name: Clerodane · C20
note: A C20 diterpene parent skeleton with a fused C1–C10 decalin core, a six-carbon branch at C9 and four additional carbons (C17–C20). This connectivity model intentionally leaves stereochemistry unassigned. Clerodanes include cis–cis, cis–trans, trans–cis and trans–trans relative classes; each class can include absolute stereochemical variants.
noteKo: A C20 diterpene parent skeleton with a fused C1–C10 decalin core, a six-carbon branch at C9 and four additional carbons (C17–C20). This connectivity model intentionally leaves stereochemistry unassigned. Clerodanes include cis–cis, cis–trans, trans–cis and trans–trans relative classes; each class can include absolute stereochemical variants.

name: Decalin
note: Two fused six-membered carbon rings sharing a bond: a 6/6 bicycle. Ring fusion is unspecified in this generic model. A C10 fragment does not by itself establish monoterpenoid biosynthetic origin.
noteKo: Two fused six-membered carbon rings sharing a bond: a 6/6 bicycle. Ring fusion is unspecified in this generic model. A C10 fragment does not by itself establish monoterpenoid biosynthetic origin.

name: cis-Decalin
note: Bridgehead hydrogens on the same face. Ring-fusion stereochemistry is distinct from the complete stereochemistry of a substituted diterpenoid.
noteKo: Bridgehead hydrogens on the same face. Ring-fusion stereochemistry is distinct from the complete stereochemistry of a substituted diterpenoid.

name: trans-Decalin
note: Bridgehead hydrogens on opposite faces. Other stereocentres in substituted diterpenes must be specified separately.
noteKo: Bridgehead hydrogens on opposite faces. Other stereocentres in substituted diterpenes must be specified separately.

name: Five-membered carbocycle
note: Generic five-membered carbon ring. Ring size does not define a terpene family.
noteKo: Generic five-membered carbon ring. Ring size does not define a terpene family.

name: Six-membered carbocycle
note: Generic six-membered carbon ring. Compare this isolated ring with fused 6/6 decalin.
noteKo: Generic six-membered carbon ring. Compare this isolated ring with fused 6/6 decalin.

name: Bridged bicycle
note: A norbornane connectivity model. Camphor has a related bridged bornane skeleton; the generic model is not camphor.
noteKo: A norbornane connectivity model. Camphor has a related bridged bornane skeleton; the generic model is not camphor.

name: Spiro bicycle
note: Generic 5/6 spiro model: two rings share one atom. Fused rings instead share a bond.
noteKo: Generic 5/6 spiro model: two rings share one atom. Fused rings instead share a bond.

name: Macrocycle
note: An eleven-membered ring connectivity model. α-Humulene is a C15 sesquiterpene with an eleven-membered ring and is already in the molecule library.
noteKo: An eleven-membered ring connectivity model. α-Humulene is a C15 sesquiterpene with an eleven-membered ring and is already in the molecule library.

name: cis–cis clerodane
note: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: cis relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: cis relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.
noteKo: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: cis relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: cis relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.

name: cis–trans clerodane
note: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: cis relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: trans relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.
noteKo: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: cis relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: trans relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.

name: trans–cis clerodane
note: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: trans relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: cis relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.
noteKo: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: trans relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: cis relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.

name: trans–trans clerodane
note: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: trans relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: trans relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.
noteKo: Relative stereochemical model, not an assignment of one natural product. First descriptor: trans relationship of H10 and the C19 methyl at C5 (C5/C10 ring fusion). Second: trans relationship of the C17 and C20 methyl groups at C8/C9. This is one of four relative classes; enantiomers and other stereocentres are not fully specified.

name: β-Carotenoid end group
note: The β-type C9H15 end-group connectivity with R marking continuation into the carotenoid chain. The ring double bond lies at the chain-attachment carbon and can be conjugated with the polyene. β-Carotene has two β ends; α-carotene has one β and one ε end. This is a labelled fragment, not a free precursor or β-ionone molecule.
noteKo: R은 carotenoid 사슬의 연장을 나타내는 말단기 모델입니다. 사슬 결합 탄소에 고리 이중결합이 있습니다. 유리 전구체나 β-ionone 분자를 그린 것이 아닙니다.

name: ε-Carotenoid end group
note: The ε-type C9H15 end-group connectivity with R marking continuation into the carotenoid chain. The ring double bond is displaced from the chain-attachment carbon, interrupting conjugation with that ring. The stereocentre at the attachment carbon is deliberately unassigned in this generic fragment. α-Carotene and lutein have a ε end; zeaxanthin has β ends.
noteKo: R은 사슬 연장을 뜻합니다. β형과 달리 고리 이중결합이 사슬 결합 탄소에서 벗어나 있습니다. 이 일반 모델의 입체중심은 미지정입니다.

name: Furanoclerodane / 1 lactone (example)
note: An actual Borapetoside C molecular record with its furan and 1 lactone ring highlighted. Sugar and other decorations remain visible. This is a composite ring reference, not a bare parent skeleton or an assigned Tinospora pathway intermediate. The selected borapetoside C database stereochemistry must be read with the published C6 revision and source caveats.
noteKo: 선택한 borapetoside C 구조의 furan 고리와 lactone 고리 1개를 강조한 실제 분자 예시이다. 당과 methyl ester를 그대로 유지하며, 단순한 모골격이나 입증된 생합성 중간체를 뜻하지 않는다. C6 당 결합의 문헌 수정과 선택한 데이터베이스 입체표현의 주의점을 함께 확인한다.

name: Furanoclerodane / 2 lactones (example)
note: An actual Columbin molecular record with its furan and 2 lactone rings highlighted. Sugar and other decorations remain visible. This is a composite ring reference, not a bare parent skeleton or an assigned Tinospora pathway intermediate. A comparator record does not establish occurrence in every Tinospora species.
noteKo: 선택한 columbin 구조의 furan 고리와 lactone 고리 2개를 강조한 실제 분자 예시이다. 고리 수와 연결 위치를 비교하기 위한 자료이며, 모든 Tinospora 종에서 같은 경로나 중간체를 가진다는 뜻은 아니다.

name: Acyclic C10
note: An acyclic C10 framework, illustrated by geraniol. The drawing retains the selected example's double bonds and oxygen; it is not a saturated parent or a pathway intermediate.
noteKo: Geraniol을 예로 든 비고리형 C10 골격입니다. 실제 예시의 이중결합과 산소를 유지하며, 포화 모체나 별도의 생합성 중간체를 뜻하지 않습니다.

name: p-Menthane
note: The p-menthane carbon framework, illustrated by (-)-limonene. Menthone, menthol and beta-phellandrene retain this C10 framework while differing in unsaturation, oxygenation or stereochemistry. The class name does not assign one stereoisomer.
noteKo: (-)-Limonene을 예로 든 p-menthane 탄소 골격입니다. Menthone·menthol·beta-phellandrene도 이 C10 골격을 가지며 이중결합·산소 작용기·입체배열이 다릅니다. 계열명만으로 특정 입체이성질체를 지정하지 않습니다.

name: Pinane
note: A bridged bicyclic C10 framework, illustrated by (-)-alpha-pinene. This is a structural-class model; it does not depict a free saturated pinane intermediate.
noteKo: (-)-alpha-Pinene을 예로 든 가교형 이중 고리 C10 골격입니다. 자유로운 포화 pinane 중간체를 그린 것이 아닌 구조 계열 모형입니다.

name: Bornane
note: A bridged C10 framework, illustrated by the stereounassigned camphor reference. Bornyl diphosphate and bornyl acetate also share bornane connectivity. Class I bornyl diphosphate synthase retains diphosphate; retention alone does not imply TPS II.
noteKo: 입체배열 미지정 camphor를 예로 든 가교형 C10 골격입니다. Bornyl diphosphate·bornyl acetate도 같은 bornane 결합 골격을 가집니다. Diphosphate를 유지하는 bornyl diphosphate synthase도 class I입니다.

name: Acyclic C15
note: An acyclic C15 framework, illustrated by farnesol. FPP hydrolysis can supply farnesol; this is distinct from terpene cyclisation.
noteKo: Farnesol을 예로 든 비고리형 C15 골격입니다. FPP 가수분해는 고리화 반응과 구분합니다.

name: Humulane
note: The humulane framework is illustrated by alpha-humulene and its eleven-membered carbocycle. Ring size does not change the C15 skeletal class.
noteKo: Alpha-humulene의 11원 탄소 고리를 통해 humulane 골격을 보여줍니다. 고리가 커도 C15 골격 계열은 바뀌지 않습니다.

name: Caryophyllane
note: The caryophyllane framework is illustrated by the selected beta-caryophyllene reference, including its four-membered ring. This is framework membership, not a conversion to a saturated parent.
noteKo: 선택한 beta-caryophyllene 기록의 4원환을 포함하는 caryophyllane 골격입니다. 포화 모체로의 전환이 아닌 계열 소속 관계입니다.

name: Amorphane
note: The bicyclic amorphane framework, illustrated by the fully assigned amorpha-4,11-diene reference. Downstream artemisinin formation involves several additional oxidative and reductive stages.
noteKo: 입체배열이 지정된 amorpha-4,11-diene을 예로 든 amorphane 골격입니다. Artemisinin 형성까지는 추가적인 여러 산화·환원 단계가 필요합니다.

name: Eremophilane
note: Valencene, nootkatol and nootkatone illustrate the eremophilane-type C15 framework. The shared decalin-related topology does not make them C20 diterpenoids. Historical nootkatol names require stereochemical qualification.
noteKo: Valencene·nootkatol·nootkatone은 eremophilane 계열 C15 골격의 예입니다. Decalin 관련 고리를 가져도 C20 diterpenoid가 되지 않습니다. 과거 nootkatol 명칭은 입체배열을 함께 확인해야 합니다.

name: C40 · ψ,ψ
note: An open-chain C40 carotenoid class, illustrated by lycopene. Phytoene and desaturation-stage references share the open-chain carbon skeleton but differ in unsaturation and geometry.
noteKo: Lycopene을 예로 든 열린 사슬 C40 carotenoid 계열입니다. Phytoene과 탈수소화 단계 참고 구조는 열린 탄소 골격을 공유하지만 불포화도와 기하배열이 다릅니다.

name: C40 · β,ψ
note: One beta ring and one open psi end, illustrated by gamma-carotene. Cyclisation takes place on the C40 chain; a free beta ring is not a co-substrate.
noteKo: Gamma-carotene은 beta 고리 하나와 열린 psi 말단 하나를 가집니다. C40 사슬 위에서 고리가 형성되며, 분리된 beta 고리가 공기질로 들어가는 것은 아닙니다.

name: C40 · ε,ψ
note: One epsilon ring and one open psi end, illustrated by the stereounassigned delta-carotene record. The scaffold card does not assign the ring stereocentre or an organism-specific product configuration.
noteKo: 입체배열 미지정 delta-carotene으로 epsilon 고리 하나와 열린 psi 말단 하나를 보여줍니다. 이 모형은 고리의 절대배열이나 특정 생물의 생성물 배열을 지정하지 않습니다.

name: C40 · β,β
note: Two beta end groups, illustrated by beta-carotene. Hydroxylation and ketolation yield related xanthophylls while retaining the represented end-group framework. Astaxanthin esterification retains the C40 core; acylation is decoration, not a new skeleton.
noteKo: Beta-carotene을 예로 든 beta 말단 고리 두 개의 C40 계열입니다. Hydroxylation·ketolation 후에도 표시한 말단 골격은 유지될 수 있습니다. Astaxanthin ester화는 C40 핵심 골격을 유지하며, acyl화는 새로운 골격이 아닌 치환기 변형입니다.

name: C40 · β,ε
note: One beta end and one epsilon end, illustrated by the selected alpha-carotene record. Lutein is a hydroxylated member. Beta versus epsilon describes end-ring double-bond placement, not cis/trans geometry.
noteKo: 선택한 alpha-carotene은 beta 말단 하나와 epsilon 말단 하나를 가집니다. Lutein은 수산화된 계열원입니다. Beta/epsilon은 고리 이중결합 위치의 구분이며 cis/trans 기하배열과 다릅니다.

name: Iridoid core · lactol example
note: A C10 iridoid illustrated by cis-trans-nepetalactol, with a five-membered carbocycle fused to a six-membered oxygen heterocycle. The source-defined core stereochemistry is retained; the C1 lactol anomer remains unassigned. This is an actual compound example, not an extra saturated pathway intermediate.
noteKo: Cis-trans-nepetalactol로 C10 iridoid의 5원 탄소 고리와 산소를 포함한 6원 융합 고리를 보여줍니다. 원 출처의 핵심 입체배열을 유지하며 C1 lactol anomer는 미지정입니다. 실제 화합물 예시이며 추가적인 포화 경로 중간체가 아닙니다.

name: Iridoid lactone · ring variant
note: The nepetalactone example retains the fused 5/6 iridoid topology. Oxidising the matching lactol introduces an ester carbonyl and removes its C1 anomeric centre. This is an oxidation-state and ring-function variant, not a separate carbon skeletal family.
noteKo: Nepetalactone 예시는 iridoid의 융합 5/6 고리를 유지합니다. 대응 lactol을 산화하면 ester carbonyl이 생기고 C1 anomeric 중심이 사라집니다. 별개의 탄소 골격 계열이 아닌 산화 상태·고리 작용기의 변형입니다.

name: Artemisinin · peroxide ring system
note: Artemisinin illustrates an oxygen-rich C15 ring system with an endoperoxide O–O bond, a six-membered 1,2,4-trioxane ring and a lactone. Late oxidative chemistry creates the oxygen bridges; this card does not imply that one TPS directly forms artemisinin.
noteKo: Artemisinin은 endoperoxide O–O 결합, 6원 1,2,4-trioxane 고리와 lactone을 포함하는 C15 고리계의 예입니다. 산소 가교는 후기 산화 화학에서 형성되며 단일 TPS가 artemisinin을 직접 만든다는 뜻이 아닙니다.

name: Kaurane · ent-kaurene example
note: The tetracyclic C20 kaurane framework is illustrated by ent-kaurene, retaining its selected absolute configuration and exocyclic double bond. The represented ring set has three six-membered carbocycles and one five-membered carbocycle. This is an unsaturated example, not an additional saturated kaurane intermediate.
noteKo: 입체배열과 고리 밖 이중결합을 유지한 ent-kaurene으로 사중 고리 C20 kaurane 골격을 보여줍니다. 고리 집합에는 6원 탄소 고리 3개와 5원 탄소 고리 1개가 있습니다. 불포화 예시이며 추가적인 포화 kaurane 중간체가 아닙니다.

name: Gibberellin framework · GA12
note: GA12 illustrates the C20 gibberellin framework after plant KAO-mediated ring-B contraction. Its tetracyclic carbon framework contains two five-membered and two six-membered rings. The formula and carboxylic acids belong to this GA12 example, not a hypothetical hydrocarbon parent. Other gibberellins can have C19 skeletons.
noteKo: GA12는 식물 KAO의 B 고리 축소 후 형성되는 C20 gibberellin 골격의 예입니다. 사중 탄소 고리에는 5원 고리 2개와 6원 고리 2개가 있습니다. 분자식과 carboxylic acid는 이 GA12 예시의 것이며 가상의 탄화수소 모체가 아닙니다. 다른 gibberellin 중에는 C19 골격도 있습니다.

name: Taxane · taxadiene example
note: Taxadiene illustrates a tricyclic C20 taxane framework with a 6/8/6 carbon ring topology. Unsaturation and stereochemistry belong to the selected taxadiene example. Taxadiene synthase uses GGPP directly as a class I TPS, without a required preceding class II cyclase.
noteKo: Taxadiene은 6/8/6 탄소 고리 형태의 삼중 고리 C20 taxane 골격을 보여줍니다. 불포화도와 입체배열은 선택한 taxadiene 예시의 것입니다. Taxadiene synthase는 선행 class II 효소 없이 GGPP를 직접 사용하는 class I TPS입니다.

name: C40 poly-cis · geometry variant
note: Prolycopene has four cis double bonds at 7,9,7′,9′ and the same carbon connectivity as all-trans lycopene. It remains an acyclic C40 ψ,ψ framework. Poly-cis describes geometry, not a new skeletal class or ring type; CRTISO changes this geometry in the plant pathway.
noteKo: Prolycopene은 7,9,7′,9′에 cis 이중결합 4개가 있으며 all-trans lycopene과 탄소 연결 구조가 같습니다. 비고리형 C40 ψ,ψ 골격을 유지합니다. Poly-cis는 새로운 골격 계열이나 고리 종류가 아닌 기하배열이며 식물 경로에서 CRTISO가 이를 바꿉니다.

name: C40 epoxy end rings · ring variant
ko: C40 epoxy 말단 고리 · 고리 변형
note: The selected 9-cis-violaxanthin example has two three-membered 5,6-epoxide rings fused to six-membered carotenoid end rings. This changes ring functionality while retaining the C40 carbon skeleton. It is a ring variant, not a new carbon skeletal family; the defined 9-cis geometry matters for NCED cleavage.
noteKo: 선택한 9-cis-violaxanthin에는 6원 carotenoid 말단 고리에 융합된 3원 5,6-epoxide 고리 2개가 있습니다. 고리 작용기가 바뀌어도 C40 탄소 골격은 유지됩니다. 새로운 탄소 골격 계열이 아닌 고리 변형이며 지정된 9-cis 배열은 NCED 절단에 중요합니다.
aliases: C40 epoxy end rings · ring variant
C40 epoxy 말단 고리 · 고리 변형

name: ABA C15 · cleavage framework
note: Natural (+)-(1′S,2Z,4E)-ABA illustrates an oxygenated six-membered carbocycle and a dienoic-acid side chain. Its C15 apocarotenoid framework derives from C40 cleavage through xanthoxin and abscisic aldehyde. Carbon count alone does not make it an FPP-derived sesquiterpenoid.
noteKo: 천연 (+)-(1′S,2Z,4E)-ABA는 산소 작용기가 있는 6원 탄소 고리와 dienoic-acid 곁사슬의 예입니다. C15 apocarotenoid 골격은 C40 절단 후 xanthoxin·abscisic aldehyde를 거쳐 유래합니다. 탄소 수만으로 FPP 유래 sesquiterpenoid로 분류하지 않습니다.
